_command_log.name: docs_updated
_command_log.command:
api_changed=$(git diff --name-only {base_commit}..HEAD | grep -cE 'routes/|api/|endpoints/|models/|schemas/|openapi/' || true)
doc_changed=$(git diff --name-only {base_commit}..HEAD | grep -cE 'README|docs/|CHANGELOG|\.md$' || true)
if [[ $api_changed -gt 0 && $doc_changed -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "WARN: API files changed ($api_changed) but no docs updated"; exit 1
fi
